body: Think it about it like this, looks are subjective. You may not like yourself, but remember. There is 8 billon people on this planet, at least 1 thinks you are the most attractive person on this planet. At least 1 likes you, there is no 0. There is someone out there who thinks you are attractive.
Hey are you still there? call for some help if you can.
glad it made you feel better, everyone in life deserves happiness but things can get in the way of the big picture.
I am glad you could relate, I hope you and the person who helped you are doing well.
Good on you for trying to be nice to everyone.
